title: Earth Views from the ISS - No Music
contents: Continuous real-time daytime view of Earth from the International Space Station: deep-blue ocean, cloud bands and curved horizon against black space. No music. Note: the source has no night/aurora/city-lights segments, and no Korea-at-night clip was found in the NASA library.
